findings.observation: Gold short-muzzle creature, cream muzzle/chest, compact pointed ears and dark eyes are consistent across standing, open-mouth and prone poses. Gray wrist detail stays localized; pose occlusion does not force extra visible ornaments.

Facing and the arm/foot support remain source-aligned. Cream lower face and abdomen simplify the selected A concept at native scale. New ear pixels are concentrated above the head within the existing canvas.

The left-facing mouth opening stays readable as a dark cavity with pale upper edge/teeth. The repaired limb pixels retain the original visible support; front/rear foot directions remain distinct. This is independently authored extended-mouth art, not a stretched neutral frame.

The low horizontal body retains the source head/forefoot/rear extension arrangement. Flattened eyelid and cream muzzle maintain identity; ears are a deliberate head contour addition rather than an extra appendage used for support.

All three technical records report zero removed source support pixels, and contain respectively 13, 3 and 12 added pixels. Visual comparison places the additions in the intended head/ear/face contour area; zero removal is supporting evidence, not a skeleton proof.
